propositions: Core outbound link diffing compares vendor link shapes, violating Epic bbf1 AC3 (zero adapters.jira imports in core) and ADR 0035 §(d) requiring core to compare only canonical shapes.

Both link translations move onto the SupportsLinks capability: map_remote_links returns a canonical set of (relation, remote_key, opaque_vendor_type) and link_payload_for_relation returns (vendor_type, swap).
Core _diff_links/_diff_link_removals compare local ticket deps against the canonical set in relation vocabulary, leaving ADD/REMOVE payload keys unchanged so the apply path is untouched.
Unknown remote link types (relation=None) are ignored for matching and never removed, and REMOVE payloads carry the original vendor type name via the opaque passenger.
The ADD dedup stays direction-agnostic: a local dep to K dedups against a remote link on (opaque_vendor_type, remote_key) whether K is the inward or outward side.

outbound_differ.py's compute_outbound_mutations passes the SupportsLinks capability as a new argument into _diff_links, and the AST neutrality gate is extended to assert zero adapters.jira imports in outbound_links.py.
